evidence.statement: Q2 2026 revenue was approximately $1.924B and H1 2026 revenue approximately $3.766B; Q2 GAAP operating income was approximately $1.494B.
Q2 company-defined free cash flow was approximately $863M.
The Apps business was sold in 2025, concentrating AppLovin on its advertising platform.
AppLovin reports advertising revenue net of publisher inventory payments because it concludes it acts as agent rather than principal for that inventory.
H1 2026 share repurchases were about 3.275M shares for $1.533B and the diluted weighted-average share count declined year over year.
H1 2026 repurchases imply a mechanical average price of approximately $468 per share.
FY2025 repurchases were about 5.511M shares for approximately $2.198B.
FY2025 repurchases imply a mechanical average price of approximately $399 per share.
H1 2026 SBC was about 4.5% of revenue and period-end share count declined versus year-end.
Reuters reported in February 2026 that an SEC investigation involving AppLovin remained active; the reviewed evidence did not establish a formal finding of wrongdoing.
FY2025 audit opinion and internal-control opinion were clean.
Independent industry data supported a strong position for AppLovin in mobile-gaming advertising monetization.
Current economics are consistent with a highly scalable and asset-light advertising engine, but reported operating margin should not be compared mechanically with gross-revenue ad platforms.
Repurchase-price discipline deserves a meaningful discount until contemporaneous intrinsic-value evidence supports the high 2025-H1 2026 purchase prices.
At $305.06, the stated 9% DCF using a $4.22B FCF-minus-SBC proxy implies roughly 11.1% five-year owner-cash growth with 3% terminal growth.

source_resolution: Source details and URLs are stored in reviews/2026-09-10-app-meli-deep/source-manifest.json.
limitations: Advertiser-level ROAS, retention and traffic-quality evidence remains incomplete.
The SEC investigation is unresolved; investigation status is not treated as proof of misconduct.
The $305.06 price is a research reference quote, not an executable trading instruction.
Valuation is especially sensitive to normalization of 2026 margins and owner cash.
